tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med mchog stsol bzhugs so// na mo gu ru uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dza ya/ /bde gshegs gtsug tor las byon pa'i/ /bde gshegs yum gyur rnam rgyal mar/ /bde gshegs 'grub phyir gus btud nas/ /bde gshegs rnam rgyal grub dkyil bshad/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor du/ /mngon par dbang bskur sgrub 'dod pas/ /gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /stegs bu ras bzang gis bkab pa'i/ /steng du maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma'i dbus/ /dri yis yi ge gru bzhi dang / /phyogs mtshams brgyad du zlum brgyad dang / /de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi ru/ /phyogs rer zlum bzhi re sgrigs dang / /de yi phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad/ zlum po re dang bcas pa'i steng / /me tog tshom bu re bkod de/ /mañdzi la sogs steng du bzhag de yi 'og nas mdun gyi char/ /sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu'ang dgod/ /de yi phyi rol byang shar gyi/ /mtshams su mtshams 'dzin me tog dang / /chu gsum sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rnams/ /shar nas brtsams te gru bzhir bshams/ /shar gyi phyogs su lhan cig dang / /phyogs bzhir drug re mtshams bzhi ru/ /gnyis re'i grangs dang ldan pa yi/ /bdug spos mar me zhal zas ro/ /g.yas skor dag tu gru bzhir bsham/ /sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal nye logs su/ /gtor ma gcig bsham 'byor gyur na/ /dgos mchod kyang bshams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lho nub nas brtsams shar lho'i bar/ /cha gsum gtor ma legs par bshams/ /slob dpon mdun du rdor dril dang / /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis/ /legs bkrus kha tshar ma nyams pa'i/ /ras bzang mgul chings srog lnga 'am/ /bdun pas legs bcings mtshan ma gdags/ /drag sngags bzla zhing gu gul gyis/ /legs bdug yungs kar dag gis brab/ /gtsang ma'i chu yis gsum nyis dgang / /'bru lnga sman lnga rin chen lnga/

/snying po lnga dang dri lngas bkang / /ku shas kha rgyan de steng du/ /dung chos dri bzang chur bcas dang / rdo rje gzungs thag kyang bshams shing / /logs su slob ma sta gon chas/ /nyer spyod so shing khyor chu dang / /dpung skud ku sha sogs bsham mo/ /cho ga dngos la sta gon dang / /dngos gzhi gnyis kyi dang po la/ /bdag bskyed bsgom pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni bdag nyid khrus byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod de/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ mchod yon la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sarka ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥprak+ṣo ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs gsum brjod cing rol mo bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas/ dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes bdun nam nyer gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che nas/ rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi nas/ rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /rang nyid skad cig gis rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta pra ṇa me na ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa sarka ra pā d+yaṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ thal mo sbyar nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ nas/ 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum gyis thun mong ba'i sdom pa bzung nas/ mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs pas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshogs kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i phyir/ oṃ shū n+yā ta sogs nas ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sra zhing mkhregs la dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i logs su rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba/ 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bre phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur yangs shing rgya che ba'o/ /zhes srung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ 'byung bzhi lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dbang po'i bzhugs gnas gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i khra yis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i steng rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng na gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang rnga yab dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / me long dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/

bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dang / steng du mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba/ de dag gi bar rnams su/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zur rtse bzhir gdugs bzhis mdzes shing / phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ gzungs ma sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed bzhin pa sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi mtshams dang zur bzhi zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi'i steng du/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi'i sa gzhi la rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / rtsibs rnams la pad+ma'i gdan gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi dang / grwa bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ lha'i gnas thams cad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsam mo/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo ba cung zad khros pa'i tshul can mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar bsnams pa/ gnyis pa pad+ma'i steng na rgyal ba 'od dpag med bzhugs pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub gnyis pa na gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ bzhi pas mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du bsgom mo/ /shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la nam mkha' 'byung ba'i gtsug tor sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag lhor nor bu'i snying po 'byung ba'i gtsug tor ser po/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag nub tu 'od dpag med snying po 'byung ba'i gtsug tor dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du rnga sgra'i dbyangs 'byung ba'i gtsug tor ljang gu g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gsum po thams cad kyang mnyam bzhag gi steng du 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ shar lhor sa'i snying po 'byung ba'i gtsug tor sngon po/ lho nub tu rdul gyi snying po 'byung ba'i gtsug tor ser po/ nub byang du gzi brjid snying po 'byung ba'i gtsug tor dmar po/ byang shar du rlung gi sgra dbyangs 'byung ba'i gtsug tor ljang gu thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa rnams mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pa rnams mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe yis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang ral pa'i cod pan dang / dar lnga'i stod g.yogs dang sham thabs mnabs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can no/ /phyi rol gyi pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug la zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du shar nas g.yas bskor gyi rim pas nang stong pa nyid 'byung ba'i gtsug tor dang / phyi stong pa nyid 'byung ba'i gtsug tor dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid༞

stong pa nyid stong pa nyid༞ don dam pa stong pa nyid༞ 'dus byas stong pa nyid༞ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid༞ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid༞ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid༞ rang bzhin stong pa nyid༞ chos thams cad stong pa nyid༞ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid༞ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid༞ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid༞ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid༞ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid 'byung ba'i༞ de thams cad sku mdog dmar po sprul sku'i rnam pa can zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du sgo bzhi dang / grwa bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re'i steng du/ shar du lha'i bu'i bdud rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i lha mo rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog sngon mo g.yas tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor 'chi bdag gi bdud rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i lha mo rnam par rgyal ma ser mo g.yas dbyug pa/ nub tu nyon mongs pa'i bdud rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i lha mo rnam par rgyal ma dmar mo/ /g.yas pad+ma/ byang du phung po'i bdud rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i lha mo rnam par rgyal ma dmar mo g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor phreng ldan ma zhes bya ba'i tshe'i yum sngon mo/ bden bral du sgyu ma chen mo ser mo/ /rlung du gser 'od ma dmar mo/ /dbang ldan du tshe'i yum gser gyi phreng ldan ma ljang gu rnams phyag gnyis kyis 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir bkod pa'i rnam rgyal lha mang gi sgrub thabs 'di ni rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung sgros las 'byung ba bzhin gtso bor bkod pa yin la/

dze twa ris mdzad pa'i bstod par ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma dang / shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir gtsug tor/ dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / khang bzang / bum pa/ rgyal mtshan/ bdud rtsi 'dzin pa/ mtshams rnams phyogs kyi phyed mdog can/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'od stong / rnga zlum/ gling bu 'dzin pa/ pad 'dab bcu drug gi gtsug tor thams cad ser po/ pad+ma zla tshes chos 'byung brtsegs ma 'dzin pa/ sgo mtshams kyi lha rnams phyogs bzhi'i mdog can/ tho ba/ dbyug pa/ pad+ma/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir phyogs kyi phyed mdog can/ rdo rje'i phreng ba/ rgyu ma/ glegs bam/ gser phreng 'dzin par gsungs so/ /sa bzang 'phags pas ni nang gi gtsug tor dbus ser po g.yas 'khor lo bkod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ 'dab ma'i gtsug tor bcu drug dkar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ sgo bzhi'i lha phyogs mdog mtshams bzhi dkar sngo ser dmar te/ brgyad ka'ang bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin par bzhed do/ /rigs bdag rang chas su bsam pa ni/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bh+rūṃ dkar po de las rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i lha tshogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / lha mo dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ skal pa ji lta bar chos ston pa la sogs pa gzhan la phan pa rnams mdzad de/ bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing / slar 'dus nas bdag nyid la thim/ de nas bzlas pa ni spro bsdu'i tshul gyis bzla bya'i sngags ni gzungs ring ci nus dang / oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i snying po dang / oṃ a mṛ ta ā yuḥd dai swā hā/ zhes nye ba'i snying po bzlas so/

/thal mo sbyar nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / blo gros dang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang / rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa la༞ de 'khor gyi lha rnams la༞ 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso mo la thim pas rang bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod do/ /sta gon la bzhi las/ dang po sa lha sta gon ni/ mar me sogs sbar te mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ sogs nas shap+ta ā hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sa'i lha mo zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas dpang po khas len pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dkar po'i nab bza' dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi lag g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ser mo dbus ma gsum gyi rtsa bar hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lag g.yas sa la reg ste/ zhes pa'i sgra dang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos rdor 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/

/do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ hī hī hī hī hai swā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī re re mgor sbyar ba'i oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa re zhes pa nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi༞ rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang g.yas mchog sbyin dang oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seṅge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang bstsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba thob par gyur par bsam/ lag g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim/ zhes brjod la lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa nang bcings byas pa sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i hūm̐ yig 'bar ba 'phros pas dbang chen gyi sa bar rdo rjes bsdams par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍā tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te mchod gtor sogs bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sogs nas gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i nas bzhugs pa'o/

/zhes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin lha so gsum bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs nas/ shap+ta hūm̐ gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhrīḥnas shap+ta hūm̐ gis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod mar me sogs sbar te mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i sogs nas hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus pas nas rol mo'i bar dang / gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos sogs nas gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs nas/ wasatra ya hūm̐/ zhes pas phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dpal ldan lha mo zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs nas/

par+ṣe ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te hūm̐/ gi mthar kun rig bzhin brjod do/ /gtor ma cha gsum/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ a ka ro man 'dra zhing / bden bdar gyi tshe/ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ zhes sogs/ spos rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma mchog /rig pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni gtsug tor rnam par rgyal/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar byon par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /gsum ba bum pa sta gon ni/ rang gi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas rnam rgyal dang / las bum bshams pa'i mdun du dung chos dri bzang gi chu dang / rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa rnams kyis kha rgyan la g.yas skor du dkris te las bum gyi phyogs la sne 'ong bar byas la bzhag ste/

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul chings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ lan gsum dang / lha'i chu chu bo gaṅgā nas chu rgyun babs pas bum pa'i nang gi chu la thim pas dbyer med du 'dres pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / rtsibs rnams la pad+ma'i gdan/ de'i phyi'i phyogs bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ lha'i gnas thams cad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor nas na bza' can/ 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs la nas can no/ /phyi rol gyi nas bsnams pa'o/ /de'i phyir rol gyi shar du lha'i bu'i bdud rab tu zhi ba nas bzhugs pa'o/ /bar gong bzhin/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa sogs nas bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa la/ sogs nas/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ pad kor sngon 'gros gzungs thag la 'jus te/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la brten te song bas lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/

rnam rgyal la gzungs ring dang / nye snying / snying po/ las bum la las sngags rnams grangs ci rigs bzlas la thun mong du/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ ci 'grub bzla zhing / gzungs thag bsdus te/ lag tu me tog thogs la hūm̐ bdun bzlas te bum pa rnams su blug tshul bya/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa mā ya sogs lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang pad kor sngon 'gros dung chos blangs te bum pa gnyis su rim pas chu blug cing / oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ zhes dang / las bum gyi ku shas bum pa la gtor zhing las sngags brjod de/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin pa de srid du bgegs rnams zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod do/ /bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma gcig gnyis la sogs pa grangs nges can la gsungs pas de rnams khrus byas/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba rnams gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la yang gsan rgyu'i dbang bskur ba ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa de nyid kyis dang por byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed tshul/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags tshul/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang gsum las/

dang po ston pa 'di rdza mkhan gyi khye'ur gyur pa'i tshe sems dang po bskyed pa yin/ gnyis pa ni ston pa 'di gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro'i phung po la sogs pa du ma la grangs med dang po tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob pa yin/ de nyid tshong dpon shes bzang du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag la sogs pa du ma la grangs med gnyis pa bsags pas sa bdun pa thob pa dang / de nyid gzhon nu sprin du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad la sogs pa du ma la grangs med gsum pas tshogs bsags pas sa brgyad pa thob pa yin/ de nas bzung ste grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bcu pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ lang gshegs las/ /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas rnam par tshangs mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams ni 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes bya ba mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gling chen po bzhi'i sa'i lho 'dzam bu'i gling du dus bskal pa bzang po 'di la tshul 'jig rten dang mthun par mdzad pa'i phyir sred la bar chad med pa'i lam gyis bdud btul/ tho rangs rnam par grol ba'i lam gyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas mdzad pa brgya dang bcu gnyis dang bcu drug la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ /de ltar bu'i 'o skol gyi ston pa de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang / khams dang bag la nyal la sogs pa la dgongs nas chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa yin te mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ste 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyis khri chig stong /

zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod༞ gti mug la spyod pa'i gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod༞ dug gsum cha mnyam la spyod pa'i gnyen por gsang sngags kyi sde snod nyis khri chig stong rnams gsungs so/ /sde snod dang po gsum las gsang sngags kyi sde snod khyad par du 'phags tshul ni/ slob dpon ka ma la kṛ pi tas tshul gsum gyi sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rtogs bya'i chos dbyings don dam pa'i bden pa spros pa dang bral ba gcig yin te/ de ma rtogs par 'tshang mi rgya bar mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir/ thob bya'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas su mthun te/ spangs rtogs mthar thug pa la sangs rgyas su 'dod pa mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir/ 'o na thob bya'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas su mthun na/ gong du spangs rtogs la khyad par yod par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na skyon med de/ theg pa gsum gyis byang chub tu rigs gcig kyang spangs rtogs la khyad par yod pa bzhin no/ /thob byed kyi thabs byang chub kyi sems su mthun te gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blo la kun rdzob kyi sems su mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir te rtogs bya'i don gcig par brten pa yin no/ /'on kyang gang zag gi rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i thabs khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ pha rol tu phyin par sa dang po ma thob bar du chos nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa las med la/ rdo rje theg par ye shes dbab pa'i dbang gsum pa la sogs pa'i skabs su ye shes skyes pa na don gyi ye shes spros pa dang bral bar mtshon par nus pa'i dpe'i ye shes rtogs pas khyad par du 'phags chos dang po yin no/

/pha rol tu phyin pa la yod pa'i thabs rnams kyang steng du zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / don dam zab mo dang / kun rdzob rgya che ba rtogs pa'i thabs bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs mang du yod pas khyad par du 'phags chos gnyis pa yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin par mgo dang rkang lag sogs gtong ba la ltos te tshegs che ba dang / gsang sngags pa'i spyod pa bde ba las byang chub bsgrub pa la sogs pa khyad par 'phags chos gsum pa yin no/ /pha rol du phyin par gang zag dbang po rab kyis bskal pa grangs med gsum dang / 'bring gis bskal pa grangs med sum cu rtsa drug dang / tha mas bskal pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'bras bu 'grub pa dang / rdo rje theg par gang zag dbang po rab kyis tshe 'di nyid dang / 'bring gis 'chi kha'am bar do/ tha mas skye ba bdun/ shin tu tha mas kyang skye ba bcu drug nas 'grub par bshad pas khyad par du 'phags chos bzhi pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /rdo rje la dga' rtag par gnas/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs/ /rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes pa'i don/ rdo rje ni mi phyed pa dang / mi chod pas chen po yin la/ de nyid theg pa chen po yin pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa ste sngags kyi tshul dang / zhes ming gi rnam grangs de ltar du bshad pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi ming don de la sngags zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sngags rnams kyi ni mtshan nyid kyang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te/ /chos kyi snying po sgrub byed cing / /chos kyi dbyings dang yang dag ldan/ /sngags kyi mtshan nyid yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid la sngags zhes pa dang /

lha rnams la yang sngags zhes pa dang / lha rnams kyi mtshan nas 'bod pa la yang sngags zhes pa'i don yin la/ gzungs sngags ni/ yang de nyid las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dzin byed cing / chos rnams 'dzin par byed pa dang / dge ba zhes bya 'dzin byed pa/ /gzungs sngags kyis ni mtshan nyid brjod/ /ces gsungs pas gtso cher yon tan 'dzin par byed pa'i ldog pa nas gzungs sngags zhes pa yin no/ /rdo rje ni don mang po la 'jug kyang sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yin la/ theg pa ni 'dis 'dong bas na lam dang / 'dir 'dong bas te 'bras bu ste zhes pa'am/ yang na slob dpon shan+ti pas bshad pa ltar thabs shes zung du 'jug pa la bya zhing / skabs 'di'i 'bras bu'i theg pa ni/ 'bras bu 'grub pa la nye ba'i 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya ba'am/ da lta nas 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byas nas bsgoms pas na 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes pa'o/ /don de dang ldan pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba la gnyis su dbye ba dang / gsum du dbye ba/ bzhir dbye ba/ lngar dbye ba/ drug tu dbye ba las/ 'dir rgyud sde gnyis su dbye ba ni/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la phyi'i rgyud dang / thabs shes gnyis med gsum la ni nang gi rgyud la 'jog pa yin te/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ phyi nang dbye ba shes pa yis/ /rgyud sde'i dbye ba shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi'i rgyud la dbye na/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor dang gsum las/ 'dir bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba so so'i rgyud ngos bzung ba dang / spyi'i rgyud ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la drug de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud/ pad+ma'i༞ rdo rje'i༞ lnga rtsen gyi༞ nor bu'i༞ 'jig rten pa'i rgyud rigs kyi rgyud do/ /dang po la brgyad/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud dang / rigs kyi bdag po'i dang /

rigs kyi yul dang / rigs kyi gtsug tor dang rigs kyi khro bo khro mo dang / rigs kyi pho nya mo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdu ba'i byang sems kyis dang / gnas gtsang gi lha la sogs pa'i rgyud do/ /'dir rigs kyi gtsug tor gyi nang tshan gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ste/ de yang gnas skabs su dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sogs zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams blo gros byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra'i zhal snga nas bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba la sta gon dang / dngos gzhi las/ dang po sta gon gyi skabs yin/ de sa lha bum pa slob ma bzhi las/ dang po gsum po slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma sta gon du gnas pa la/ chos bcu bzhi yod pa las/ dang po lus kyis bya ba khrus byas phyag dang yon phul nas/ rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod nas/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dngos yin snyam du mos nas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ las kyi slob mas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ sngags kyi tshul la skal ba dang ldan pa rnams ni 'jig rten 'di nyid kyi mngon par mtho ba'i phyir don tu gnyer ba yang ma yin/ 'jig rten pha rol gyi mngon par mtho ba'i ched du yang ma yin gyis 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya'o/

/de ltar na mngon par mtho ba gnyis kyang mtho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dngos grub don du gnyer ba dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya yi/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang / phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang / rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub 'dod pa rnams ni ma yin te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la ma ltos par thabs dman pa gzhan la brten nas kyang bsgrub tu yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na bdag gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i dad pa can blo gros dang ldan pa dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya ste/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras don du gnyer bas zhugs na pha rol gyi don mi 'grub cing gzhan don du mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs te zhugs na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa yin/ de ltar nges par byas nas bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ dmyal ba la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro la gcig la gcig za ba dang / gsod pa dang bkol spyod kyi༞ mi la 'dod pa brtsal bas mi rnyed pa dang / mi 'dod pa thog tu bab pa'i༞ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang / lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i༞ lha 'chi 'pho dang / gong ma nas 'og mar ltung ba dang / mthar ngan song du skye bar shes pa na/ dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal bas kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal yod par bshad/ 'o na sdug bsngal de dag las rang nyid gcig pu thar ba'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na ma yin/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing /

gzhan don du phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung / mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin na shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i khams gsum gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las 'das shing snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu'i don du ma yin te/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med pas sems can re res kyang bdag gi pha ma byas shing byas res kyis gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing phan tshad med par btags pa'i drin chen sha stag yin pa la 'di rnams 'dod ni bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling tog gis ni ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang ni bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu bas ni ma zin mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas brdeg 'chos shing ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'grims pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan pas/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral/ bde ba la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin nyan rang sogs la'ang med/ su la yod na sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas bdag gis ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'ang rgyu med rkyen med pa las mi thob pas/ rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi zhing lam la ci nus su 'bad par bgyi'o snyam pas byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed 'tshal/

bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs ba'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing / tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul du 'grub pa yin te/ dper na 'bras lo legs na rtswa dang phur ma zhar las byung ba lags/ gsum pa nang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dngos yin snyam du mos gus drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang pho nya lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur par mos/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma nas/ na bza' can bar de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal btab pa ni nang dbang gi dod yin no/ /bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon sogs nas gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ de'i don ni tshigs bcad dang po'i dgongs su gsol ba dang don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu'i mchog smos nas/ de thob par byed pa'i thabs dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa ni khyad par can gyi don gyi gtso bo sngags kyi dam tshig ste dbang chog las thob pa'i sngags kyi dam tshig go

/de'i rten du byang sems kyi sdom pa thob dgos pas/ byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /de'i rten so thar gyi sdom pa thob dgos pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la bstsol/ /zhes pa 'di gnyis kyi rgyun bshags kyi skabs su thob par 'gyur ba'i byang sems kyi sdom pa dang so thar gyi sdom pa kho na yin gyi/ sngags kyi cho ga thun mong ba'i thob zin pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar sdom gsum bstsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du zhugs pa ni khyad par can gyi don yin pas de'i steng du gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /lnga pa khyad par can gyi don gsang sngags kyi lam la spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab pa gda' ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul can snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang zhig shākya saiṅga sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs pa'i don ni/ slob dpon gyis bu zhes pa'i nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams dad pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / shes rab chen po dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la yang rgyu phar phyin gyi theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa dang gnyis las/ khyed rnams la mchog tu gyur pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa bstan par bya yi/ sngags kyi theg pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin te/

'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang sngags kyi lam la brten pas sangs rgyas pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang sngags kyi lam la brten pas 'tshang rgya ba yin/ khyad par du yang 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing / 'og min du mngon par byang chub pa lnga yi tshul gyis sangs rgyas su zin yang / 'jig rten pa rnams rjes su drang par bya ba'i ched du slar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan te gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas rtag par zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa yin no/ /de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i nye lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba ni shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin pas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi lam las blo gzhan du 'gyur ba ma byed cig ces spro ba bskyed pa yin no/ /drug pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa 'dzin pa'i lha dang lha mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa byas nas de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs nas/ 'grub par shog /ces rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing /

thob zin yar 'phel du byed la/ nyams na sor chud par yang byed pa yin no/ /bdun pa de ltar byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i bh+rūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta/ sogs brjod cing bar chad bsrungs te/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du mas yar reg ste/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po rnams lam gyis byung bar mos/ de rnams las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thugs gsung sku'i phyag mtshan yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje ma lha gsum gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ brgyad pa de la mchod pa ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ spyi bor me tog mdun du spos/ /mar me dri ni snying ga ru/ /kun byed bzlas nas gus pa yis/ /slob ma rnams la sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum lhar bskyed ma thag pa de mchod yul du bzung ba yin pas me tog dbu la phul ba'i sgo nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bras sam nas mgor bzhag de bzhin bdug spos shangs༞

dhu pe༞ mar me spyan lam du༞ ā lo ke༞ thugs kar dri chab༞ ghan+dhe༞ zhes brjod cing mchod nas lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin/ dgu pa mthun rkyen dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtags pa la thog mar so shing la brten pa brtag pa'i slad du/ so shing la las bum gyi chu gtor te bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi cod pan dang bcas pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥdzi hoḥbadz+ra saṃ war+dha ni ye swā hā/ zhes ci rigs bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥdzi hoḥ sogs kyis sbyin pas/ so shing de nyid rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos pa byas te so drud pa bzhin byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer zhal nas brgyud de khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin du so shing gi rwa ba ru nag chil gyis skyugs par mos nas rim pa ltar du byon nas/ slob dpon la kha phyogs par oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ/ zhes gsungs shing thal mo kha phye ste/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du ltos pa med par 'dor bar zhu/ de yang rtse mo shar du bstan na zhi ba'i dngos grub dang / lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ rang dang bla ma la mchog gi༞ mtshams rnams su bstan na dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes skabs su gang babs de brda sprod do/ /bcu pa rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba'am ngag dag par bya ba'i phyir khyor chu sbyin pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las byung ba'i khyor chu rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i khyor chu de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi g.yas pa'i khyor mor lan gsum byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥbi shūd+dha sarba dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing brud do/ /bcu gcig pa rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir srung skud sbyin pa ni/ srung skud la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam par gsum sgril du byas pa la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul de rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig gi srad bu la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs mang du bzlas te/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i srad bu de nyid skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas la nyis bskor du bcings/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs las sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chu gtor te rdo rjes mnan/ oṃ bud+dhe mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarban swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / sangs rgyas byams pa ma byon gyi bar du srungs shig ces pa'i don yin/ bcu gnyis pa rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang nyal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha che chung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang gnyis rtsa rtse ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

ces dang / oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hās byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ dhīḥbazlas pas ku sha chung ba de nyid phyag g.yas par sngas dang / ha bzlas pas che ba de nyid g.yon par stan gyi don du byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa baṃ/ zhes brjod cing byin no/ bcu gsum pa chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag sogs nas/ 'gyur zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni 'jig rten na gang dkon na u dum wā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar du sangs rgyas dkon/ de yang sangs rgyas gcig 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dum wā ra'i me tog gcig 'byung / sangs rgyas de yang rgyal rigs las 'byon na dkar po dang / bram ze'i rigs las 'byon na ser po 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de lhum su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bu/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu'i rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston pa na me tog de yang skams nas 'gro ste/ des na de gnyis dkon mtshungs yin pas/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dkon/ byon nas kyang chos gsungs pa dkon/ chos kyi nang nas kyang theg pa chen po gsungs pa dkon theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos gsungs pa shin tu dkon te/ des de bzhin du bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon par gsungs kyang / gsang sngags gsung ba po ni thub pa'i dbang po 'di kho na yin te bstan pa la smon lam gyi stobs kyis byon pa yin pas na shin tu dkon/ dkon pas ci phan ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i pad+mo yang dkon no snyam na/ de dag dang mi mtshungs te dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dper na brag phug kha byang bltas su sngar snang ba gtan yang ma myang ba lo grangs mang por song ba der mar me chung ngu zhig btegs pa na mun pa de na re lo grangs mang por bsdad pa yin gyi khyod kyis gsal bar mi nus mi zer bar mar me chung ngu de skyes ma thag tu mun pa de med par 'gyur ba chos nyid yin no/

/dpe de bzhin du bskal pa bye ba du ma nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams kyang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi tshon rtse phra mo tsam mthong ba'i mod la dag par gyur na dbang bskur legs par zhus/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byas nas sngags kyi spyod pa bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can nyams su len pa dang / gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i lam 'di la blo brtan par byas na ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyun gcod par 'gyur bas na khyod rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi rdo rje theg pa 'di la khyed rnams mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste/ de'i rigs su skye bzhin par 'gyur bas na sang nyin dbang bskur bas skyes pa yang brten par 'gyur zhing / theg chen gyi 'bras bu bla na med pa 'byung ba'i lam mchog tu gyur pa 'dis tshe 'di nyid la 'grub pa dang / 'bring gis 'chi kha'am bar dor 'grub pa dang / tha mas skye ba bdun nam bcu drug na rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bshad pa dang / mdor na dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang sang nyin mjal bas na thugs dga' spro rgya chen po mdzod cig ces 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed de gang gi bu tshur sogs ni lam la spro ba bskyed pa yin pas zlos skyon du mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la drang por smros/ /zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'am/ yang na rang gi gnas khang du shar ram byang du sngas brten pa'i dge ba'i mal zhig bcas te/

slob dpon gyis byin pa'i ku sha chung ba de sngas kyi don du phred dang che ba de stan gyi don du dkyus la bting ste/ rab tu byung ba yin na rang gi chos gos snam sbyar gyis gril ba dang / khyim pa yin na gos dkar po dri ma med pas gril te glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab la lag pa g.yas pa'i steng du 'gram pa bzhag lag g.yon pa brla g.yon gyi steng du bzhag la seng ge'i nyal stangs kyis nyal te/ sems can nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs pa'i rnam rtog rnams rgyang ring du spangs nas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha yid la dran bzhin pas sang nyin yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin ldan pas nyal na rmi lam du mkha' 'gro rnams kyis lung ston par 'gyur te/ de yang spyi rgyud las/ thos nas bzang dang mi bzang ba/ the tshom med pa shes par bya/ /rmi lam thams cad bden min yang / /de la ma dang rig ma yin/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dang po'i thun gyi rmi lam gang / /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ mtshan mo la thun bzhir bcad pa'i thun tha ma tho rangs kyi cha rmi lam shin tu gsal bas de la brtags dgos te/ de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ kri ya las/ bla ma sangs rgyas dge slong dang / /sku gzugs mchod rten mthong zhing mchod/ /rgyal por dbang bskur slob ma 'dzin/ /mdo sde klog pa la sogs shis/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang / mchod rten mthong ba dang / de dag la mchod pa rtsom pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su bzhugs pa dang / chos nyan pa dang / khri bzang po'i khar 'dug pa dang / nyi zla shar ba dang / rgyal por dbang bskur ba dang / bzhon pa'i mchog rta dang glang po che la sogs pa rmis na rmi lam bzang po'i ltas yin pas/

spyi rgyud las/ /dge ba 'di yi ltas rnams ni/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma las/ /gsang sngags dngos grub rnam gsum po/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma 'grub/ /ces gsungs pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring tha gsum gang rung 'grub par shes par byas nas bden zhen med pa'i sgo nas dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya bar rigs pa yin no/ /gal te na ngan pa yang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni sdom 'byung las/ rgya skyegs ri la 'dzegs pa dang / /ka ra wā ri'i me tog 'thu/ /phreng ba dmar po gyon pa dang / /srin pos zos pa la sogs ngan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa dang / /ka ra wā ri'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba dang / /mchod sdong dang / bye ma dang / thal phung la 'dzegs pa dang / spre'u la zhon nas lho'am shar phyogs su 'gro ba dang / bong bu la zhon nas kha lhor bltas nas ma log pa dang / srog chags gdug pa can phag pa dang / rnga mong dang / ma he sogs la zhon nas kha lho phyogs su bltas te phyir mi ldog pa'i bsam pas 'gro ba dang / bud med nag mo rab tu khros pas lto ba dral ba dang / bud med nag mo gos nag gyon pa la 'dod pa spyod pa dang / re ba nag po'i gos gyon pa dang / g.yang sa dang gcong rong du zhugs pa dang / ri dang shing lo lhung ba dang / ljon shing 'bras bu med pa skams pa mthong ba dang / khyi dang khwa dang srin pos zos pa dang / mi nag po lcags kyi dbyig pa thogs pas bdag nyid la bsdigs pa dang / de nyid kyis 'khyer ba'am khrid pa dang / skra breg pa dang / lus til mar gyis byugs nas phreng ba dmar po'i thod bcings pa dang / 'dam rdzab tu bying ba dang / nyi zla nub pa dang / chus khyer ba la sogs rmis na cung zad ngan pa'i ltas yin pas gnyid sad ma thag chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyis sbyang bas rgyas 'debs pa dang /

bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsrung ba dang / zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa 'bul ba la sogs pa rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin/ des sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub pa yin/ 'di'i dngos gzhi sang nyin nyi ma 'di tsam la 'byung / zhes brjod de/ slob dpon gyis/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang la rjes kyi bya ba rnams la 'jug go /gsum pa rjes ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i chu gsum nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang / gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog la/ hūm̐ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ sang dkyil 'khor du spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes dang sngar ltar mchod bstod dang / dngos grub len pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ zhes sogs kyis bsrung la/ bsngo ba smon lam skabs su gang babs ci shes dang / ston mchog dam pa sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ sta gon byas pa'i gzhi der 'di'i bris sku rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs par bkram/ spyi mchod sgos mchod cha gsum rnams sngar bzhin du bshams/ gzhan yang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang / gtsug tor mig ras me tog dang / /gu gul yungs chu kham phor dang / /ba lce'i changs bu zan chang dang / /ting lo dang ni sang ras so/ /dri dang me tog mchod yon dang /

/mar me sa rdza'i bdug spos dang / /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs rdo rje dril/ /mig thur me long mda' gzhu dang / /snam sbyar 'khor lo dung dril bu/ /pu ri rin chen sna bdun gzugs/ /mthong brgyud phyag len bzhin du bshams/ /gnyis pa ni mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sogs nas/ skur gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sta gon bzhin no/ /mdun bskyed kyis ras bris bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sogs nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi rten dang brten par sogs nas/ dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas mar me sogs sbar te sogs nas cha gsum btang ba'i bar gong bzhin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyi ting mnan nas nang du 'ong la sgo khang du slebs pa na tsog pur 'dug la lag g.yon mthil du chu gtsang ma blugs la/ lag pa'i gru mo gnyis pus mo'i bar du tshud par byas la g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis chu blangs te kha'i ze'u 'bru la lan gsum/ mig gnyis/ rna ba'i bu ga gnyis/ ya mchu/ ma mchu/ g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma/ g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma/ lto ba mgor yang reg ste/ chu de nyid kyis kha bshal la g.yon phyogs nas phyir 'pho/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis rgyab kyi kha'i gsher rnams g.yas g.yon du phyis pa de la nye reg ces sa khrus kyi ming yin no/ /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥ sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor du zhugs la 'dod snam gyi steng nas bskor ba byas par bsam zhing dngos su dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas te/ rdor dril gsil zhing yig brgya lan gsum brjod pas lhag chad kha bskangs nas shar phyogs su 'ong la/ dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba/ /thar pa'i grong du bcom ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog gi bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis/

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrab tu 'grub par mdzod/ zhes dga' ba'i bsam pas glu blangs shing gar byas te/ gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa twa me bhā wa hṛ da ya mi a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añtsa li nā tha hoḥ zhes dang / me tog rang gi mgo la bcings par bsams te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa sogs brjod la/ phyag gsum byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing stan la 'dug go /de nas 'jug cing dbang blang ba la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ las bum mam dung chos chu thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī hūm̐ bar spyi 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i mthar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi thad pa la dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don sogs 'dra/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyed 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khyed bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon sogs nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ bar 'dra/ oṃ zhes brjod pas rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/

tshar gcig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅka ra wasta pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ smad g.yogs dmar po gyon par mos/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ gis stod g.yogs sngon po bsam/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis thor cog bcings par bsam/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra me na ye hūm̐/ gis gdong 'ching tshul/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ gis me tog len tshul/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ las bum gyi chu gtor te/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ dpral par oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ de rnams las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing dag hūm̐ rang nyid dkyil 'khor shar sgor 'khod/ kyai/ dga' ba la dga' khyed su yin/ /ci la dga'/ zhes dang / bde chen bdag ni skal bzang la'o/ /rang gi thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ snying gar me tog rdo rje dang bcas pa reg oṃ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed/

gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang mi bya'o/ /zhes phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang 'jug gi slad du me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor phyogs la mgo dud pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥya man+ta krita hūm̐/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'dod pa'i snam bu'i steng na phar yid kyis bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar du byas par mos/ ma hā ra ta su ḍi ḍa su twa ṣā su du ṣā badz+ra satwa ā t+ya sid+dhi māṃ/ zhes bskor ba tha ma de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod par mos nas phyag byas pa ni/ mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje'i thal mo brkyangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la byin gyis rlob par gsol ba'i yid kyis lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu tsa u paṣ+ṭha nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mi bskyod pa gnyis pa zhig mched de/ snying khar thim pas byin gyis brlab par mos/slar yang de nyid nas rnam snang gi nga rgyal gyis rdo rje thal mo brkyangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la byin gyi rlabs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pas yid kyis lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pu dza u pas+d+ya na ma/ āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ/ zhes pa'i phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las rnam snang gnyis pa zhig mched de snying gar thim pas byin gyis brlab par mos/

slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'dod pa'i snam bu'i steng nas phar la g.yas bskor gyis lho sgo nas rin 'byung gi nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying khar sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis dpral ba sa la reg pa'i phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza a bhi ṣe ka ta at+mā naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las rin 'byung gnyis pa zhig mched de/ dpral bar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos/ slar yang sogs nas nub sgo nas 'od dpag med kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba'i yid kyis kha sa la reg pas phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza pra war+dha nā ya at+mā naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta dharmā tsakra pra war+dha ya māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las 'od dpag med gnyis pa zhig mched de/ mgrin par thim pa sogs nas/ byang sgo nas don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdag la 'phrin las bzhi gsol ba'i yid kyis spyi bo sa la reg pas phyag byas par mos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza karmā ne āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karmā ku ru māṃ/ zhes pas phyag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las don grub gnyis pa zhig mched de spyi bor thim pas sogs nas shar sgor 'khod/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo rje btsun ma la sems can gyi don 'grub par mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la lus thams cad sa la reg pas phyag byas par mos/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇa pu dza u paṣ+ṭha nā yā āt+mā naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/

oṃ sarba satwa pa ri pra ṇar+thā ya āt+mā naṃ ni yā ta yā mi/ zhes pas phyag byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo las gtso mo gnyis pa zhig mched de/ snying khar thim pas sems can gyi don 'grub par byin gyis brlabs par mos/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi nas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs rnams bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol btab lan gsum/ sems kyi phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ myang 'das kyang bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu de nyid du nges par byas nas/ āḥzhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo skya rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pas sku lus 'degs bzhin pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa gsal btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma lta bu 'phros pas rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas lus rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'dar yid yid gnas pa'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te snying khar thim/

mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las kyang de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste rang gi snying gar thim/ yang 'od zer tshad med pa du ma 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshad med grangs med pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ zhes dang / rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing / 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su brjod/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /de ring khyod la 'bebs par mdzad/ tshar gcig oṃ badz+ra a we sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes mang du brjod cing dbab bo/ /de ltar ye shes phab pa/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la 'dod snam gyi steng nas bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar du byas par mos/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod cing mthar dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgor 'khod par mos/ de nas lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprad pa'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la gsol ba gdab cing bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug pa 'di/ /lha rnams kyis ni rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra bar/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor ba ni thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams gsal btab ste/ de rnams las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang bas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par mos shing / oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha wa sha shwa twa me bha wa/ hrī da ya me a d+dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha ha ha ha ha hoḥ

ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añtsa li nā tha hoḥ zhes me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa twa i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes spyi bor bcings/ mig gnyis su oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ yig rnams gsal btab/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /thams cad spyan ni 'byed par mdzad/ /oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ ma rig ling thog dang mig ras lhan cig tu bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor lta bar bskul ba ni/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ste nyid la ltos/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya lnga yis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyis phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyed 'gyur gyi/ /gsang sngags rnams la bsgrub par gyis/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mngon sum du mthong ba yin no/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas par bsams te/ oṃ rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag gzhug go /oṃ rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ sa ma ya ho ho ho/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs gong bzhin la/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru do tsam spangs pa'i sar dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa sgo gcig nub tu bstan pa/ dkar dmar nag pa'i rwa ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i nang du lha rnams rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus su mtshan ma dang bral ba phyogs kyi 'dab ma la shar du 'khor lo/ /lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/

byang du ral gri rnams kyis mtshan pa/ snam bu la bum pa la sogs pa bkod pa'i dbus su shing stan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma nas/ na bza' can du gsal ba'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung dang 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sarka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shap+ta ā hūm̐ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas las/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal/ /de ltar 'di la gnang bar zhu/ lan gcig thugs ka nas bye ba'i gtso mo phyag gnyis pa zhig byon te/ sbyong ba mdzad par bsam ste/ sbyong chas bsam pa la las bum gyi chu gtor/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs brjod/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang dbang len pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad yungs kar gyis sbyangs/ oṃ sarba pa pāṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ g.yas su bskor/ yang oṃ sarba sogs g.yon du bskor/ oṃ sarba sogs gnyis kas g.yas su bskor zhing me dang chu nang du dor ro/ /de bzhin du chus sbyangs/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces chu nang du me cung zad blug go /kham phor dkar po so ma btang bas sbyangs/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ ba lce'i changs bu dang /

dur ba'i myu gus sbyangs/ oṃ sarba ma la a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zan chang dang ting lo me 'bar bzhin pas sbyangs/ oṃ puṇ+ye dzñā na dha re saṃ bhod+dha ka ye swā hā/ bsangs ras dkar pos sbyang bar mos/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ rdzas drug po 'di dbang po drug gi glud du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ zhes dang las sngags brjod cing phyir dor bar mos/ de nas nye reg bya ba'i don du tsog pur 'dug pa'i pus mo gnyis kyi bar du khyor mos chu bzung / g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis chu blangs te kha'i ze'u 'bru la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su nye reg byas pas 'bags pa dang ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyang bar mos nas/ kha'i ze'u 'bru la lan gsum/ mig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna bug gnyis/ mchu gnyis/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ mgo bo'i steng / lto ba la byabs pa'i tshul bya/ mthar kha bshal nas g.yon phyogs nas phyir 'pho ste g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis rgyab kyi kha'i gsher rnams g.yas dang g.yon gyis phyi tshul bya skabs/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes mang du brjod so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥpra wa ra sarka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes hūm̐ rjes mar spos rgya/ las bum gyi chu gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las glang pos btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gnyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyis lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs te dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul ba dang bcas pa'i me tog gi char phab cing / bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol bar gyur/ ces dang / bum pa btegs te/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ me tog gtor zhing / bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kun gyi rje/ /ma lus sems can skyong byed bde ba chen po nyid/ /bkra shis kyis ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/

zhes pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas bum pa bzung / g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ ma hā su ṣa badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka ṇa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no pa/ ḍ-i ḍho me bha wa/ zhes dang / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ/ zhes spyi bor bum pa bzhag mthar bum chu 'thung / zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag rgyud la bde chen ye shes mngon sum du byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wid+ya āḥhūm̐ gis mchod nas/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa yin no/ /de'i 'og ma bzhi la rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du sogs nas/ rta mchog gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trāṃ las rin po che cha dgu pa'i lte bar trāṃ gis zhes pa nas gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che cha dgu pa dang bcas pas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas cod pan du gyur par mos dbang bskur ba'i slad du zhes pa nas/ bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod pan re thogs te/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtugs te dbang bskur bar mos/ ral pa'i thor gtsug gis brgyan pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang /

dar dpyangs cod pan dag gi dbang / /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku tra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tshar gcig oṃ badz+ra dha tī shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ spyi bo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+rūṃ/ dpral ba/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rna ltag g.yas/ oṃ dharmā badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag pa/ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su dbu rgyan reg rjes gyon/ kha dog lnga pa'i dar dpyangs/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ badz+ra ru ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes dbang bskur nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par mos/ oṃ rat+na saṃ bha wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i zhes pa nas/ rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥyis mtshan pa las zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug 'dzin pa/ zhes pa nas/ gsol ba btab nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhes pa nas rdo rje re thogs nas snying mgrin spyi bo rnams su gtugs te mthar g.yas su byin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung / oṃ ma hā su khaṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu sogs nas mos/ oṃ ā mṛ ta bha wa sa pā ri wā ra sogs nas/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob pa yin no/ /don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang sogs nas/

nam mkha' lding gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar āḥyis mtshan pa sogs nas/ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon du byin te/ chos kyi dril bu bla na med/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrogs pas/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ zhes dbang bskur nas sngar gyi rdor dril lhan cig thugs kar bsnol nas rdo rje 'chang gi nga rgyal gyis lus kyi nang thams cad byang chub sems kyis gang bar mos/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ḍe āḥ.āḥ bcom ldan gzung ngo bdag la ni/ /yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod/ /tshar gcig gis nga rgyal bzung nas/ de nyid brtan pa'i sogs nas/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi sa pā ri wā ra sogs nas/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob pa yin no/ /rnam snang ming gi dbang bskur ba'i sogs nas/ seng ges btegs pa'i sogs nas/ oṃ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa sogs nas/ gyur pa las rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bsnams sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar sogs nas mos rdor dril spyi bor dkrol te/ rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba'i/ /ming gi dbang ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye/ dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/
