/de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chu sogs/ oṃ bai ro tsa na sa pa ri wā ra sogs rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /de ltar na me tog gi phreng ba'i dbang la sogs pa thob pa spang bya zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spang zhing / gnyen po ye shes lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud 'chad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i theg pa'i rgyud sde rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por rab tu gnas par byas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor te dbu rgyan sogs bsdu'o/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas sngags kyi bzlas lung zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bcom ldan 'das ma rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ste zhal nas thon rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod/ ces dang / gzungs ring thung rnams lan gsum brjod/ me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bdag la bsgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/

/'di la bsgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ zhes mig thur byin brlabs/ g.yon par bu 'dzin tshul/ g.yas rdo rjes mig 'byed tshul byas la/ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bsal/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥpraṃ/ a las skyes pa'i me long bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /der ni gsal dag rnyogs pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas med par/ /chos rnams de ltar shes nas khyod/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye/ /gang yang rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni kun tu 'gro ba shes par gyis shig ho las skyes pa'i mda' gzhu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga satwaṃ/ zhes pas byin phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu mda' 'phen tshul byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las zhes pa nas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad sogs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rdor dril gsor zhing / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/

/khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dhā ra yā mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes byin pa'i rdo rje de spyi bor bzung / deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa thul la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la gnas par gyis shig lung bstan pa ni/ g.yon pas chos gos snam sbyar gyi grwa ri dwags bag phebs pa'i rna ba ltar dang / g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhūr+bhū ba swā hā/ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ zhes rkang 'og tu 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ zhes lag g.yas su dung / oṃ badz+ra ghan+ḍe āḥ zhes g.yon du dril bu/ a/ lag gnyis bar du pu sti byin par bsams la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor ba/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ zhes pa ni/ chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya rnams byas la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/

/de bzhin chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje༞ rin chen༞ pad+ma༞ sna tshogs zhes pa kha spo zhing / de ltar sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rnams bskor la sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus sgra sgrogs bshad pa gyis shig rin chen sna bdun gyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ ma 'ongs pa na thub pa'i dbang po yi/ /go 'phang thob phyir 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i dbang phyug bla med thob phyir du/ /rin chen sna bdun rjes gnang sbyin par bya/ oṃ sap+ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dang / the tshom med pa'i bsam pa yis/ /khyod 'di blo gros ngan mi bya/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul mchog 'di/ /mnyam med rang gis rab gsal bya/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan btags byas pa gzo bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyed la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ /skyon med dogs pa bral ba yis/ /de ltar sems can don gyis shig /rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis lus la rgyan gos bzang pos brgyan/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can re thogs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum gyi bar du byas par mos/ ma hā ra tā sogs brjod/ gdugs dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas logs su bzhag ste dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag lan byas pa'i tha mar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul bar mos nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud tsam byas la/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /de ltar phul bas dkyil 'khor ba thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ da ni khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang brgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par gyur/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/

/khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /deng 'dir khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad khyod la 'chi ba med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu mtha' 'grub bo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro/ /khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /bdag po nyid du khyed nges so/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med do/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'dod pa kun la spyod pa khyod/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med spyad par gyis/ /slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis/ /mi bya cung zad yod ma yin/ /ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin/ /'di ltar yi ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster brtan par gyis/ /'gro ba bde ba nyung las rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pas rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ de nas sogs spyi 'gre/ rdo rje 'dzin/ dril bu bsil/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan nas/ kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /bar lan gsum bya'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i mtshams sbyor ni thar rtse paṇa chen gyi grwa rnga'i dbang chog la khyad chos rnams bdag 'jug ltar ma 'dres par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams gso ba nas brtsams te lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bar sta gon bzhin las khyad par/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor la las kyi rjes bsdu dge ba bsngo zhing / bkra shis dang dga' ston bya'o/ /'khor lo'i rigs kyi gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'chi med mchog stsol 'di/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid spel ba'i phyir/ /gser 'phyang lo la rang rigs sku mched gnyis/ /chos khri mtshan mchog gsum ldan ga la bar/ /mnga' gsol shis brjod me tog char dbab tshe/ /'jigs med sbas pa'i gzhung dang mthun par bkod/ /'di la 'gal dang ma 'dres bzlog pa sogs/ /nongs pa gang mchis bdag blo rmongs pa'i skyon/ /yin phyir bla ma lhar bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /sngon bsags sdig dang lhan cig sbyang du gsol/ /legs par 'bad pa'i dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i char/ /rnam rgyal thugs rje'i sprin las dbab pa de/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i dge legs kun 'phel nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi sgrub dkyil lhan cig bkod pa 'chi med mchog stsol zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la lugs 'di'i bka' rnam dag tu nos shing / rje btsun de nyid kyi thugs rje kho nas 'tsho ba sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi rigs kyi bu dbang sdud snying po dang e waṃ bzang bo mched dpal sa skya'i chos khri chen por mnga' gsol ba'i tshe sku gegs sel zhing /
